--[[
This is a Lua block comment.
It spans multiple lines and must not be split into a line comment.
]]

-- this line comment mentions if and while but must not be counted
function withLineComment(x)
    return x
end

local longString = [[
a long bracket string literal
]]

local longStringEq = [==[
a long bracket string with equals padding
]==]

function withLengthOperator(t)
    if #t > 0 then
        return #t
    end
    return 0
end

-- The following members of rubyConditions (ruby.go, reused unmodified by
-- Lua since LuaReader defines no condition-category override of its own)
-- have no natural Lua spelling: "elsif"/"elseif"/"rescue"/"ensure"/"when"
-- (Ruby-only keywords LuaReader inherits by not overriding the category)
-- and "||"/"&&"/"?" (Lua spells these "or"/"and" and has no ternary
-- operator at all). Exercised here as bare tokens purely for
-- TestEveryConditionIsExercisedByTheLuaCorpus's coverage-manifest check,
-- the same convention typescript.go's "elseif" fixture and ruby.go's
-- "elseif_probe" already established -- lizard tokenizes and dispatches
-- without parsing Lua grammar, so a syntactically-invalid filler line
-- still exercises the exact condition-counting code path a REAL
-- occurrence would.
function conditionCoverageFiller(a, b)
    elsif(a)
    elseif(a)
    rescue(a)
    ensure(a)
    when(a)
    local c = a || b
    local d = a && b
    local e = a ? b
    return c
end
